records.text: I migrated a React application from React 16 to React 18 using TypeScript. I resolved dependency and compatibility problems and coordinated the migration with other developers. I maintained Node.js server-side rendering and improved SSR performance. I did not measure a percentage improvement.

I built an employee knowledge assistant using retrieval augmented generation (RAG), Node.js and document search. I implemented retrieval and connected the retrieved documents to an LLM to answer questions. I tested answers against source documents.
I used Python to build a small local data-processing prototype. I have not operated Python services in production.
I studied computer science and completed a database course project.
